name: Ditra vs Cement Board: A Tile Setter's Honest Comparison
title-tag: Ditra vs Cement Board: A Tile Setter's Comparison
meta-description: Ditra vs cement board from a working tile setter: crack protection, height, weight, waterproofing, and the rooms where each one honestly wins.
post-summary: January 12, 2027 · Ditra and cement board solve different problems, and the honest answer is room by room: uncoupling wins most wood-framed floors, board still earns its keep on walls. A tile setter's spec-by-spec comparison — height, weight, waterproofing, cost — plus the problems neither product fixes, no matter what the label promises.
